contract: NFC plus surrounding whitespace only; no case, accent, symbol, label, inflection or internal whitespace folding.

questions.prompt: Which pitch set forms a D minor seventh chord?
questions.explanation: A minor third, perfect fifth and minor seventh above D give F, A and C.

questions.prompt: Which Python literal is the Boolean value true?
questions.explanation: Python Boolean literals are case sensitive; True denotes the true value.

questions.prompt: Which Spanish word is the accented affirmative meaning yes?
questions.explanation: The affirmative sí bears an accent; si without an accent introduces a condition.

questions.prompt: Which is the regular English plural of machine?
questions.explanation: The regular plural adds s to the singular noun machine.

questions.prompt: What is the sum of the decimal numbers 1.0 and 2.5?
questions.explanation: Adding one to two and a half yields three and a half.

questions.prompt: Which note is the tonic of the C major scale?
questions.explanation: The tonic is the note that names the scale, so C is the tonic of C major.

questions.prompt: Which Python expression adds one to the integer n?
questions.explanation: The plus operator adds one; the other operations subtract, multiply or divide.

questions.prompt: Which quoted Python string contains two internal spaces?
questions.explanation: The first string has exactly two spaces between the letters a and b.
